final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT city_id AS c1, COUNT(*) AS c2 FROM address GROUP BY city_id), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c2 * 1.0 / s2.a AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT SUM(c2) AS t FROM s3) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c2 * 1.0 / s4.t AS c4 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.t IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c4 DESC LIMIT 10
